# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.2 Shared Normative Core

Document identity: `SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_CORE v0.1/draft-r0.2`

Status: implementation-blind Stage B draft; not owner-accepted or frozen.

The complete shared normative authority is the following six files in this
fixed order, byte-bound by `SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_MODULE_BINDING v0.1/r0.2`:

1. `normative/NOTATION.md`
2. `normative/DEFINITIONS.md`
3. `normative/EQUATIONS.md`
4. `normative/ASSUMPTIONS.md`
5. `normative/REQUIREMENTS.md`
6. `normative/PREDICTIONS.md`

Binding file: `NORMATIVE_MODULE_BINDING.json`

Binding-file SHA-256:
`5c6f954b457a546abcf74a1dc6dae190f2b22ea43c14edf34d2e4d2a8a704268`.

Each module's exact digest appears in that binding file. A byte change to any

summary, rationale, ECS procedure, table, or PDF rendering supersedes the
modules. The normative-core PDF appends their exact text in the stated order.

# Draft ceiling

The core is an implementation-blind proposal. It does not establish
implementation conformity, validation, calibration, physical-noise validity,
covariance completeness, Gaussian significance, achieved performance,
readiness, freeze, or production authorization. Explicit pending owner
questions remain unavailable rather than receiving invented defaults.
